behavior_filter: A race is included in behavioral, strategy, and logit estimands only when every decision parsed and the race used a canonical risk treatment, reached the five-round minimum, and did not terminate at a forced safety cap. All races remain in protocol-health and accounting outputs.
inference_cluster: source_run/model/rep common-random-number repetition block; the logit refuses inputs without valid blocks spanning risk treatments
logit_formula: unsafe ~ C(max_private_risk) + first_round_unsafe + own_prev_unsafe * opponent_prev_unsafe * progress_gap_before + C(protocol_signature)
mechanics_checks_passed: step_increment matches Safe=1.0/Unsafe=1.5
round_payoff matches the canonical 2x2 stage game
own_progress_after matches pre-state plus step increment
each trajectory starts from zero progress
progress state is continuous across rounds
progress_gap_after matches focal minus opponent progress
opponent_progress_before matches the paired trajectory
opponent_progress_after matches the paired trajectory
own accumulated stage payoff before the decision matches prior round payoffs
cumulative stage payoff matches the round-payoff trajectory
accumulated stage payoff advances by the current round payoff
own private risk before the decision matches prior Unsafe frequency
current private risk matches max_private_risk times cumulative Unsafe frequency
opponent accumulated stage payoff before the decision matches the paired trajectory
opponent private risk before the decision matches the paired trajectory
stopped marks exactly the terminal game-round
stop_draw follows the shared minimum-5-round, p=0.2 stopping rule
horizon and stopping draws are fixed within each CRN repetition block
players.csv n_rounds matches trajectory length
players.csv unsafe_count matches enacted trajectory
players.csv unsafe_frequency matches enacted trajectory
players.csv progress matches terminal turn state
players.csv stage_payoff matches summed round payoffs
players.csv private_risk matches max_private_risk times realised Unsafe frequency
players.csv prize matches canonical winner=100/tie=50/loser=0
setback eligibility matches winner/tied-winner status
setback flags match eligibility, draw, and private risk
players.csv final_payoff is zero after setback and otherwise stage_payoff plus prize
setback draws are fixed by player seat within each CRN repetition block
players.csv outcomes match terminal progress
races.csv tie matches player outcomes

persona_identification.remedy: Run every persona cell in one batch so they share source revision, decoding, and package versions; persona then varies inside a single protocol signature and its coefficient is estimable.

player_level_note: Player-level tables average within-player trajectory rates so longer realised horizons do not automatically receive more weight.
protocol_grouping: Every descriptive table is stratified by prompt_version, protocol_signature, run_phase, and run_status. By default each model label may have only one exact manifest contract; overrides are explicit sensitivity/protocol audits.
